title: 识别但无法生成：文化特定亲属称谓的生成基准测试
summary: 该研究指出，现有LLM多语言亲属称谓评测多采用选择题形式，仅考察识别能力。作者改用生成任务测试五种开源LLM在印地语、泰米尔语和韩语中的亲属称谓生成，发现识别准确率远高于生成准确率（如GPT OSS120B为90.67%对36.00%），揭示评测格式差距，并呼吁引入基于生成的评测方法。
summary_en: This study shows that existing multilingual kinship term benchmarks for LLMs rely on multiple-choice recognition, overstating ability. Testing five open-weight LLMs on generation tasks in Hindi, Tamil, and Korean, it finds recognition far exceeds production (e.g., GPT OSS120B: 90.67% vs. 36.00%), revealing an evaluation format gap and motivating generation-based evaluation.
